title: Stopping a cloud job throws away an image already paid for
description: Cloud Stop (js/services/cloudExecutor.js) only aborts the client fetch; DeepInfra finishes and bills the run, and routes/deepinfra.js still saves the output to %TEMP%/cubric-deepinfra, but the gallery has already dropped the job so no card is made. Proven 2026-09-25: Fabio Stopped a Flux Pro run, the jpg landed at 17:16 local with no card (aa9dca8b-...jpg). Decision needed: let a Stopped cloud job finish in the background and save the paid result (card still lands), and/or warn on Stop that the run is billed anyway. Found under MPI-908.
